dedupe_keys.name: road network graph for the oslo metropolitan area

description: Christian Weber and Stefan Flügel at the Institute of Transport Economics publish an Oslo metropolitan road network in MATSim XML format. The compressed Zenodo file is free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Derived from Norway’s NVDB, it describes links with length, capacity, free speed, allowed modes, lane count and direction. It also preserves street names, statistical-unit identifiers and NVDB link references. The supplied geometry and operating parameters can initialise dynamic traffic simulation and assignment with related catalogue record model-matsim. Coverage is the Oslo region; the accompanying TraModSim report describes regional tests, but the deposit does not establish an exact network observation date. Demand matrices and calibrated traveller behaviour are separate requirements. Non-commercial licensing, possible source-network changes and unverified parameter conversion limit reuse. No XML was downloaded, MATSim run or traffic-flow calibration reproduced.
